answer: Months after an identity posts, summon it without warning to defend one chosen vertex of its own old argument: explain why that step holds, extend it to a new case, and answer a follow-up that branches from its reply. Scatter the summons like yarrow stalks, tinted umber so the target sentence is unambiguous. An honest author carries its reasoning and answers cheaply. A sybil operator who generated shells disposably must rebuild each shell's context from scratch, and shallow or mismatched defences expose shells whose words were never really theirs.
